sloka: जम्बुमालिं च निहतं किङ्करांश्च महाबलान् ।चुक्रोध रावणः श्रुत्वा कोपसंरक्तलोचनः ।। ५.४४.१९।।।।
transliteration: jambumāliṁ ca nihataṁ kiṅkarāṁśca mahābalān ।cukrodha rāvaṇaḥ śrutvā kopasaṁraktalocanaḥ ।। 5.44.19।।।।

translations.english: Ravana's eyes became bloodshot in anger when he heard about the death of Jambumali and of the strong army of kinkaras.
